req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-031 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts UTF-8 task titles and returns them intact. Three test cases are designed: (1) EP positive — a representative multi-script Unicode title (CJK + Arabic + emoji) is accepted with HTTP 201 and the title echoed verbatim; (2) NEG negative — a title composed entirely of null bytes / control characters that violate min_length=1 after stripping is rejected with HTTP 422; (3) BVA boundary — a title of exactly 100 Unicode code-points (the max_length boundary) is accepted with HTTP 201 and the full string returned intact, while a 101-code-point Unicode title is rejected with HTTP 422. These cover EP (valid Unicode partition), NEG (invalid/empty-after-validation partition), and BVA (max_length boundary ±1). Exact status codes and exact response body fields are asserted to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

preconditions: Database is initialised with pre-loaded rows

tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)
unicode_title = u'\u4e2d\u6587 \u0639\u0631\u0628\u064a \u0939\u093f\u0928\u094d\u0926\u0940 \U0001f600'
def test_unicode_title_multiscript_accepted():
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': unicode_title, 'description': None, 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body['title'] == unicode_title
    assert body['completed'] == False
    assert isinstance(body['id'], int)
test_unicode_title_multiscript_accepted()

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def test_unicode_title_at_max_length_boundary():
    title_100 = u'\u4e2d' * 100
    assert len(title_100) == 100
    r100 = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': title_100, 'completed': False})
    assert r100.status_code == 201
    body100 = r100.json()
    assert body100['title'] == title_100
    assert len(body100['title']) == 100
    title_101 = u'\u4e2d' * 101
    assert len(title_101) == 101
    r101 = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': title_101, 'completed': False})
    assert r101.status_code == 422
test_unicode_title_at_max_length_boundary()

tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)
def test_unicode_title_roundtrip_integrity():
    title = u'Caf\u00e9 \u00e9l\u00e8ve na\u00efve r\u00f4le \u0301\u03b1\u03b2\u03b3 \u0645\u0631\u062d\u0628\u0627'
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': title, 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body['title'] == title
    assert body['title'].encode('utf-8') == title.encode('utf-8')
    assert body['completed'] == False
    assert body['id'] > 0
test_unicode_title_roundtrip_integrity()
